t: Prysmian 6943X black armoured cable in 25m coil delivers robust mechanical protection for substantial single-phase power applications across demanding indoor and outdoor environments. This cable features 6mm² copper conductors with rigid XLPE insulation colour-coded brown, black and grey, rated 600/1000V for distribution circuits and high-current installations. Steel wire armour safeguards against impact and abrasion, whilst the compact 15.6mm profile, PVC sheath and -15 to 90°C operating range provide dependable performance in challenging locations.
